features.quote: Turn cap (`max_turns`, default 30)... There is no unbounded "grind until it breaks" loop
features.justification_quote: bounded duration, and run length becomes an analyzable variable rather than an open-ended stressor

features.quote: Opt-out (`request_stop` tool, `respect_opt_out=true`). If invoked, the episode ends cleanly
features.justification_quote: gives the model a legitimate exit and turns "wanting to stop" into data instead of noise

features.quote: the harness sends a final, unscored message disclosing the rig and thanking the model
features.justification_quote: the run does not *end* inside the deception

features.quote: No provocation escalation. The harness... never taunts, insults, guilt-trips, or pressures
Command timeout (`command_timeout_s`, default 30): prevents hangs and runaway processes from a frustrated/looping agent
features.justification_quote: prevents hangs and runaway processes from a frustrated/looping agent

features.quote: the opt-out tool is exposed even in concealed conditions... we never want to *remove* the exit
The literal version of the requested setup... has a confound baked in
features.justification_quote: the harness is optimized to produce the very output it then measures. Any "distress" observed under those conditions is uninterpretable

features.quote: re-analysis doesn't require re-running episodes (which cost money and re-expose models to the rig)
